outcome: Additional clinically useful information regarding cardiovascular anatomy and function
cohort: The cohort consisted of 31 fetuses referred for fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance examination by a pediatric cardiologist after an inconclusive echocardiograph.
finding: Fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging provided additional clinically useful information regarding cardiovascular anatomy and function in 84% of referred cases, affecting patient management and parental counseling.
mod_finding: Fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging provided diagnostic information that affected the choice of mode of delivery in challenging cases of congenital heart defects.
